whitespace.rule: Whitespace separates ordinary written tokens. Typed prefix parsing determines application boundaries across those tokens.

lexical_compounds.rule: Adjacent registered roots with no whitespace or pipe form one lexical compound candidate.

pipe_binding.rule: A maximal pipe-connected token group is a hard grouping boundary and must parse to exactly one complete semantic expression before the surrounding whitespace-token stream can consume it.

examples.Move|A|B C: hard-bound Move(A,B) followed by outer token C

grouping.purpose: Strong explicit grouping when whitespace inference or pipe binding cannot express the desired unique parse clearly.
